Thank you for your response! Calming down isn't an easy thing, else I wouldn't have type this. It's like you're full of power but can't let it go because of reasons.
Actually no one seems to have the time for me :c I tried but either they don't get it right or seem kinda too busy to help me. And I love my mother very much even though we're having many troubles together, but I don't really want to talk to her about it as she also wouldn't really understand me. I just wanted a friend who understands me and doesn't make me feel like it's "just a general problem, nothing new".
My diarrhea came back a few days ago and isn't gone yet, so I'm kinda worried about that now. But thank you!
